family.assumptions: Paired exact and interval calculations assume IID pairs; adaptive joint-pair dependence is not established.
family.outcome: both predicted front-area numbers occur in the draw
family.primary_endpoint: one pre-fixed D2 per model per draw

future_trial.enrollment: Requires explicit official issue/deadline, authority, external pre-draw seal and an independent new registered issue cohort.
future_trial.stopping: Fixed N final analysis. Missing issues block completion; no early winner selection.

hypotheses.R45-EWMA: Fixed half-life20 recency improves D2 over the same-period NULL.
hypotheses.R45-HOT60: Last-60 marginal popularity improves D2 over the same-period fixed-seed NULL.
hypotheses.R45-PAIR-RESIDUAL: Removing count(a)*count(b)/60 from last-60 pair count improves D2 over NULL and reduces marginal-hotness confounding.
hypotheses.R45-PAIRWISE-D2: Last-60 raw pair counts improve D2 over the same-period NULL.
hypotheses.R45-SHRINKMIX: The fixed 50/50 marginal mixture improves D2 over the same-period NULL.

improvement_spec.predecessor_contrast: Descriptive rate difference only; not an additional confirmatory hypothesis

method_references.title: NIST Wilson and exact binomial intervals

assumptions: IID paired observations and stable alternative success rates
Fixed discordance scenario, no exact-power guarantee
Bonferroni planning is conservative relative to Holm critical values
156 draws/year is a scale illustration, not a verified future schedule
Fresh prospective periods with trusted pre-draw sealing still required

references.title: statsmodels: Exact McNemar uses the binomial distribution

secondary_inference: Fixed-lambda fair-null mixture e-process, separate globally adjusted family; never used to choose a different winner.
stopping_rule: One final historical analysis after every planned issue; no outcome-driven extension, seed change, or repeated fitting to this audit-test.
